user_query: I'm organizing a conference for my company and we need help with travel arrangements for our attendees. Can you recommend travel portal development solutions that offer travel API integration and travel portal software? We would also like to verify the contact details of the accommodations and conference venues. Please provide information on available APIs and their pricing.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of travel portal development solutions that offer travel API integration.
Evaluate the listed travel portal solutions for their API features and integration capabilities.
Gather the pricing information for the evaluated travel portal development solutions.
Verify the contact details of the accommodations needed for the conference.
Verify the contact details of the conference venues selected.
Summarize all the findings, including travel portal solutions, API features, pricing, and verified contact details.
